description: DPA4 alloytongqi runtime compiled and tested for one NVIDIA L20 SM 8.9; awaiting exact-image qualification.

recommended.evidence: Source sandbox L20: raw checkpoint inference, native LAMMPS run0/MD and phonoLAMMPS completed; exact-image acceptance pending.

prohibited_exact.c4_m15_1 * NVIDIA T4: T4 is absent from the current sandbox catalog and this artifact targets L20.
prohibited_exact.c16_m120_1 * NVIDIA L20: Sandbox SKU only; job submissions must use 1 * NVIDIA L20_48g.

prohibited_classes.cpu: Production artifact is GPU-specific; CPU artifact is for parity only.
prohibited_classes.multi_gpu: Only one MPI rank on one L20 is qualified.
prohibited_classes.cross_arch_pt2: Do not reuse the SM 8.9 artifact on a different architecture.

unverified: RTX 4090: checkpoint inference only, no production image qualification.
RTX 5090, A100 and RTX PRO 5000: listed in sandbox catalog but not runtime-qualified.
Other L20 SKUs: require their own execution receipts.
